title: 可以到达的最远建筑
summary: 依次跨越建筑；向上爬需花高度差数量的砖或一架梯子，向下免费，求最远可达下标。
insight: 梯子应留给已遇到的最大上升。把每次正上升放进小根堆；当上升次数超过梯子数时，用砖支付堆中最小上升。
pitfalls: 砖不足时返回当前边的起点下标
梯子可覆盖任意高度差

solutions.title: 梯子上升量小根堆
solutions.idea: 动态把梯子分配给目前最大的若干次上升。
steps: climbs 小根堆，扫描相邻建筑
正差入堆；若堆大小大于 ladders，弹出最小差并扣 bricks
bricks<0 时返回 i；扫描结束返回最后下标

code.java: class Solution { public int furthestBuilding(int[] heights,int bricks,int ladders){PriorityQueue<Integer> climbs=new PriorityQueue<>();for(int i=0;i+1<heights.length;i++){int climb=heights[i+1]-heights[i];if(climb<=0)continue;climbs.offer(climb);if(climbs.size()>ladders)bricks-=climbs.poll();if(bricks<0)return i;}return heights.length-1;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun furthestBuilding(heights:IntArray,bricksValue:Int,ladders:Int):Int{val climbs=java.util.PriorityQueue<Int>();var bricks=bricksValue;for(i in 0 until heights.lastIndex){val climb=heights[i+1]-heights[i];if(climb<=0)continue;climbs.add(climb);if(climbs.size>ladders)bricks-=climbs.remove();if(bricks<0)return i};return heights.lastIndex} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int furthestBuilding(vector<int>& heights,int bricks,int ladders){priority_queue<int,vector<int>,greater<int>> climbs;for(int i=0;i+1<(int)heights.size();++i){int climb=heights[i+1]-heights[i];if(climb<=0)continue;climbs.push(climb);if((int)climbs.size()>ladders){bricks-=climbs.top();climbs.pop();}if(bricks<0)return i;}return heights.size()-1;} };
